title: Microsoft 365
description: Each person's own Teams chats and Outlook mail: recent chats with their last message, each chat's messages, each mail folder's messages — signed in with their own Microsoft account.

setup.title: The Microsoft app people sign in through
setup.say: People sign in to Microsoft 365 with their own Microsoft account, through Superatom's own app with Microsoft — nothing to set. An organisation that wants its own app sets it in Organisation → Connectors → Sign-in apps.

setup.title: Your own Microsoft account
setup.say: Connect your own Microsoft account: a code is shown here — open Microsoft's sign-in page, enter the code, sign in and allow Superatom to read your chats and mail. What is read here is what your account may read.

fix.say: Your organisation asks an admin to approve Superatom first. Ask your Microsoft 365 admin to approve the Superatom app for your organisation, then connect again.
The sign-in was declined at Microsoft. Connect again and allow Superatom to read your chats and mail.
